before: A date control with no w:dateFormat showed a date picked in the editor alone as M/d/yyyy, and the same date set in a room, through the editing API or after a fold as the ISO date (2026-09-15), because the string value and the typed value used two formatters.
after: One formatter writes every date value, and a date control with no w:dateFormat shows the date as M/d/yyyy, the default an en-US Word writes, in the editor alone, the room, the editing API and after a fold. w:fullDate stays the ISO date.
reason: Change messages, the change log and its kinds keep their meaning, and the Yjs document format and the checkpoint format do not change. Only the shown text of a date value in a control with no format changes, and it now equals across the editor alone, the room and a fold. An ordered room admits only clients of its own code version.
